name: Second Coming Of Christ The
overview: Scripture reveals the Second Coming of Christ as a powerful and visible event when the Redeemer will stand upon the earth, as affirmed by Job's confident declaration of seeing God after bodily death. The Psalms describe God coming with consuming fire and a tempest, calling the heavens and earth to judge His people, emphasizing His authority and righteous judgment. Isaiah portrays this coming as a glorious reign of the LORD of hosts in Zion, marked by cosmic upheaval where the moon and sun are confounded. Daniel’s vision further underscores the majesty of this event, showing the Son of Man arriving with the clouds of heaven to the Ancient of Days, highlighting the divine approval and authority bestowed upon Christ at His return.
